What you can report

Concerns may involve accounts, technical issues, billing and subscriptions, privacy, unauthorized communication, data deletion or other service matters.

How to submit

Email the support address with enough information to identify and review the concern. Do not include passwords, OTPs or complete card details.

Responsible contact

A responsible grievance contact must be designated according to applicable legal requirements. No person is named and no statutory appointment is claimed until confirmed.
